_comment_yourphr: YourPHR add-on defaults (first test, jwilleke/yourphr#920). Merged into the site's configuration only while ngdpbase.addons.yourphr.enabled is true; the site's app-custom-config.json overrides any entry. No permissions yet: the first test only proves the shared session, and holds no records.
_comment_mount_path: Where the Angular app is served. The add-on rewrites the base href in index.html to this path.
_comment_web_root: Directory holding the built Angular app (frontend: yarn build -c prod, output dist/web). Empty means <add-on dir>/web, where a packaged image would copy it.
